categories.ui-quality: Frontend visual hierarchy, responsive layout, and collaborative interaction standards

standards.name: Spoke & Wheel Single Source of Truth
standards.description: Hub documents contain only indices (max 150 lines). Spoke documents own detailed specifications and declare parent hub in frontmatter.

standards.name: Governance Artifact Wiring Completeness
standards.description: All new workflows, skills, and patterns must be wired into skill-router.yaml and CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md.

standards.name: 4-Phase Problem-Solving Discipline
standards.description: Strict adherence to Ground Truth -> Research Benchmarks -> Objective Rules -> Evidence-Based Execution.

standards.name: Modular Component Architecture & SDCA Standard
standards.description: Zero monolithic UI scripts. No web module or HTML assembler may exceed 500 lines or embed raw monolithic HTML/CSS templates inline. All UI features must follow the Static Decoupled Component Assembler (SDCA) directory structure and consume centralized primitives from ui_primitives/.

standards.name: Tri-Modal Visual Intake & Collaborative Deep-Link Sharing Standard
standards.description: Visual procurement and decor modules must provide showroom photo ingestion, Pinterest CDN normalization, multi-option container pods, and URL deep-linking with active option state (?item=X&option=Y).
